verses.en: I cried unto God with my voice, even unto God with my voice; and he gave ear unto me.
verses.pt: Levanto a Deus a minha voz; a Deus levanto a minha voz, para que ele me ouça.
verses.en_web: My cry goes to God! Indeed, I cry to God for help, and for him to listen to me.
verses.en_bbe: <To the chief music-maker. After Jeduthun. Of Asaph. A Psalm.> I was crying to God with my voice; even to God with my voice, and he gave ear to me.

verses.en: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord: my sore ran in the night, and ceased not: my soul refused to be comforted.
verses.pt: No dia da minha angústia busco ao Senhor; de noite a minha mão fica estendida e não se cansa; a minha alma recusa ser consolada.
verses.en_web: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord. My hand was stretched out in the night, and didn’t get tired. My soul refused to be comforted.
verses.en_bbe: In the day of my trouble, my heart was turned to the Lord: my hand was stretched out in the night without resting; my soul would not be comforted.

verses.en: I remembered God, and was troubled: I complained, and my spirit was overwhelmed. Selah.
verses.pt: Lembro-me de Deus, e me lamento; queixo-me, e o meu espírito desfalece.
verses.en_web: I remember God, and I groan. I complain, and my spirit is overwhelmed. Selah.
verses.en_bbe: I will keep God in memory, with sounds of grief; my thoughts are troubled, and my spirit is overcome. (Selah.)

verses.en: Thou holdest mine eyes waking: I am so troubled that I cannot speak.
verses.pt: Conservas vigilantes os meus olhos; estou tão perturbado que não posso falar.
verses.en_web: You hold my eyelids open. I am so troubled that I can’t speak.
verses.en_bbe: You keep my eyes from sleep; I am so troubled that no words come.

verses.en: I have considered the days of old, the years of ancient times.
verses.pt: Considero os dias da antigüidade, os anos dos tempos passados.
verses.en_web: I have considered the days of old, the years of ancient times.
verses.en_bbe: My thoughts go back to the days of the past, to the years which are gone.

verses.en: I call to remembrance my song in the night: I commune with mine own heart: and my spirit made diligent search.
verses.pt: De noite lembro-me do meu cântico; consulto com o meu coração, e examino o meu espírito.
verses.en_web: I remember my song in the night. I consider in my own heart; my spirit diligently inquires:
verses.en_bbe: The memory of my song comes back to me in the night; my thoughts are moving in my heart; my spirit is searching with care.

verses.en: Will the Lord cast off for ever? and will he be favourable no more?
verses.pt: Rejeitará o Senhor para sempre e não tornará a ser favorável?
verses.en_web: “Will the Lord reject us forever? Will he be favorable no more?
verses.en_bbe: Will the Lord put me away for ever? will he be kind no longer?

verses.en: Is his mercy clean gone for ever? doth his promise fail for evermore?
verses.pt: Cessou para sempre a sua benignidade? Acabou-se a sua promessa para todas as gerações
verses.en_web: Has his loving kindness vanished forever? Does his promise fail for generations?
verses.en_bbe: Is his mercy quite gone for ever? has his word come to nothing?

verses.en: Hath God forgotten to be gracious? hath he in anger shut up his tender mercies? Selah.
verses.pt: Esqueceu-se Deus de ser compassivo? Ou na sua ira encerrou ele as suas ternas misericórdias?
verses.en_web: Has God forgotten to be gracious? Has he, in anger, withheld his compassion?” Selah.
verses.en_bbe: Has God put away the memory of his pity? are his mercies shut up by his wrath? (Selah.)

verses.en: And I said, This is my infirmity: but I will remember the years of the right hand of the most High.
verses.pt: E eu digo: Isto é minha enfermidade; acaso se mudou a destra do Altíssimo?
verses.en_web: Then I thought, “I will appeal to this: the years of the right hand of the Most High.”
verses.en_bbe: And I said, It is a weight on my spirit; but I will keep in mind the years of the right hand of the Most High.

verses.en: I will remember the works of the LORD: surely I will remember thy wonders of old.
verses.pt: Recordarei os feitos do Senhor; sim, me lembrarei das tuas maravilhas da antigüidade.
verses.en_web: I will remember Yah’s deeds; for I will remember your wonders of old.
verses.en_bbe: I will keep in mind the works of Jah: I will keep the memory of your wonders in the past.

verses.en: I will meditate also of all thy work, and talk of thy doings.
verses.pt: Meditarei também em todas as tuas obras, e ponderarei os teus feitos poderosos
verses.en_web: I will also meditate on all your work, and consider your doings.
verses.en_bbe: I will give thought to all your work, while my mind goes over your acts of power.

verses.en: Thy way, O God, is in the sanctuary: who is so great a God as our God?
verses.pt: O teu caminho, ó Deus, é em santidade; que deus é grande como o nosso Deus?
verses.en_web: Your way, God, is in the sanctuary. What god is great like God?
verses.en_bbe: Your way, O God, is holy: what god is so great as our God?

verses.en: Thou art the God that doest wonders: thou hast declared thy strength among the people.
verses.pt: Tu és o Deus que fazes maravilhas; tu tens feito notória a tua força entre os povos.
verses.en_web: You are the God who does wonders. You have made your strength known among the peoples.
verses.en_bbe: You are the God who does works of power: you have made your strength clear to the nations.

verses.en: Thou hast with thine arm redeemed thy people, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.
verses.pt: Com o teu braço remiste o teu povo, os filhos de Jacó e de José.
verses.en_web: You have redeemed your people with your arm, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.
verses.en_bbe: With your arm you have made your people free, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. (Selah.)

verses.en: The waters saw thee, O God, the waters saw thee; they were afraid: the depths also were troubled.
verses.pt: As águas te viram, ó Deus, as águas te viram, e tremeram; os abismos também se abalaram.
verses.en_web: The waters saw you, God. The waters saw you, and they writhed. The depths also convulsed.
verses.en_bbe: The waters saw you, O God; the waters saw you, they were in fear: even the deep was troubled.

verses.en: The clouds poured out water: the skies sent out a sound: thine arrows also went abroad.
verses.pt: As nuvens desfizeram-se em água; os céus retumbaram; as tuas flechas também correram de uma para outra parte.
verses.en_web: The clouds poured out water. The skies resounded with thunder. Your arrows also flashed around.
verses.en_bbe: The clouds sent out water; the skies gave out a sound; truly, your arrows went far and wide.

verses.en: The voice of thy thunder was in the heaven: the lightnings lightened the world: the earth trembled and shook.
verses.pt: A voz do teu trovão estava no redemoinho; os relâmpagos alumiaram o mundo; a terra se abalou e tremeu.
verses.en_web: The voice of your thunder was in the whirlwind. The lightnings lit up the world. The earth trembled and shook.
verses.en_bbe: The voice of your thunder went rolling on; the world was flaming with the light of the storm; the earth was shaking.

verses.en: Thy way is in the sea, and thy path in the great waters, and thy footsteps are not known.
verses.pt: Pelo mar foi teu caminho, e tuas veredas pelas grandes águas; e as tuas pegadas não foram conhecidas.
verses.en_web: Your way was through the sea; your paths through the great waters. Your footsteps were not known.
verses.en_bbe: Your way was in the sea, and your road in the great waters; there was no knowledge of your footsteps.

verses.en: Thou leddest thy people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
verses.pt: Guiaste o teu povo, como a um rebanho, pela mão de Moisés e de Arão.
verses.en_web: You led your people like a flock, by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
verses.en_bbe: You were guiding your people like a flock, by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
